title: litsea citriodora
intro: Litsea citriodora, commonly known as East Indian lemon-scented wood or Citriodora, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Litsea citriodora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Litsea citriodora include citral, limonene, and other terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
